patch_description: The current approach uses five static ordering seeds, two tie modes, and local move/swap/one-for-two exchange search with a `3 * model_count` iteration limit. This revision keeps the successful lexicographic local-search strategy while expanding initialization to eight pressure-aware and capacity-aware orderings. New seeds prioritize models by `weight / (80 - size)`, pressure with size secondary ordering, pressure-density, and large-model pressure risk. The local-search limit is increased to `4 * model_count` so neutral lexicographic improvements have more opportunity to unlock a lower maximum KVPR. Model weights and sizes are precomputed, reducing repeated attribute and division work during search.
